more_info.overview: Tartaric acid is an organic dicarboxylic acid; the food specification identifies the L-positive form. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. EU permissions include canned or bottled fruit and vegetables, cocoa and chocolate products as covered by directive 2000/36/ec, table-top sweeteners in tablets.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain cocoa and Chocolate products as covered by Directive 2000/36/EC; canned or bottled fruit and vegetables; table-top sweeteners in tablets.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.daily_intake: 0-30 mg/kg body weight (JECFA, 2017). The combined group limit is expressed as L(+)-tartaric acid.
